Only PubMed abstract-reported intervention-versus-control numbers or valid relative effects were recorded. Produce delivery was screened because the retrieved PubMed evidence was qualitative; psychological first aid was screened because the randomized evidence did not show the claimed positive benefit; recovery community center and red ginseng had no directly matching quantified controlled evidence; relaxation audio anxiety had a stress-focused adjunct study without a direct audio-versus-control anxiety result.
